bilgewater.title: Bilgewater
bilgewater.subtitle: Lawless port city
bilgewater.description: Bilgewater is a port city like no other—home to monster hunters, dock-gangs, indigenous peoples, and traders from across the known world. Almost anything can be purchased here, from outlawed hextech to the favor of local crime lords. There is no better place to seek fame and fortune, though death lurks in every alleyway, and the law is almost non-existent.

demacia.title: Demacia
demacia.subtitle: Proud military kingdom
demacia.description: Demacia is a proud, lawful kingdom with a prestigious military history. Founded as a refuge from magic after the Rune Wars, some might suggest that the golden age of Demacia has passed, unless it proves able to adapt to a changing world. Self-sufficient and agrarian, its society is inherently defensive and insular, valuing justice, honor, and duty above all else.

freljord.title: Freljord
freljord.subtitle: Harsh frozen land
freljord.description: The Freljord is a harsh and unforgiving land, where demi-gods walk the earth and the people are born warriors. While there are many individual tribes, the three greatest are the Avarosans, the Winter’s Claw, and the Frostguard, each uniquely shaped by their will to survive. It is also the only place on Runeterra where True Ice can be found.

icathia.title: Icathia
icathia.subtitle: Barren forbidden wasteland
icathia.description: A rebellious vassal-state of ancient Shurima, Icathia is now a barren and forbidding wasteland. And yet, amid the ruins, unspeakable horrors of the Void are beginning to stir once more...

ionia.title: Ionia
ionia.subtitle: The First Lands
ionia.description: Known as the First Lands, Ionia is an island continent of natural beauty and magic. Its inhabitants, living in loosely collected provinces, are a spiritual people, seeking harmony with the world. They remained largely neutral until their land was invaded by Noxus—this brutal occupation forced Ionia to reassess its place in the world, and its future path remains undetermined.

ixtal.title: Ixtal
ixtal.subtitle: Perilous Eastern Jungles
ixtal.description: Secluded deep in the wilderness of eastern Shurima, the sophisticated arcology-city of Ixaocan remains mostly free of outside influence. Having witnessed from afar the ruination of the Blessed Isles, and the softening of Buhru culture, the Ixtali view the other factions of Runeterra as little more than upstarts and pretenders, and use their powerful elemental magic to keep any intruders at bay.

noxus.title: Noxus
noxus.subtitle: Brutal expansionist empire
noxus.description: Noxus is a brutal, expansionist empire, yet those who look beyond its warlike exterior will find an unusually inclusive society. Anyone can rise to a position of power and respect if they display the necessary aptitude, regardless of social standing, background, or wealth. Noxians value strength above all, though that strength can manifest in many different ways.

piltover-zaun.title:
Piltover
& Zaun
piltover-zaun.subtitle: Dual city-states
piltover-zaun.description: Dual city-states that control the major trade routes between Valoran and Shurima. Home both to visionary inventors and their wealthy patrons, the divide between social classes is becoming more dangerous.

shadow-isles.title:
Shadow
Isles
shadow-isles.subtitle: Lands shrouded by the Black Mist
shadow-isles.description: The Shadow Isles were once a beautiful realm, long since shattered by a magical cataclysm. Now, Black Mist permanently shrouds the land, tainting and corrupting with its malevolent sorcery. Those who perish within it are condemned to become part of it for all eternity… and worse still, each year the Mist extends its grasp to reap more souls across Runeterra.

shurima.title: Shurima
shurima.subtitle: Fallen desert empire
shurima.description: Shurima was once a thriving civilization that spanned the southern continent, left in ruins by the fall of its god-emperor. Over millennia, tales of its former glory became myth and ritual. Now, its nomadic inhabitants eke out a life in the deserts, or turn to mercenary work. Still, some dare to dream of a return to the old ways.

targon.title: Targon
targon.subtitle: Sprawling western mountains
targon.description: A mountainous and sparsely inhabited region to the west of Shurima, Targon boasts the tallest peak in Runeterra. Located far from civilization, Mount Targon is all but impossible to reach, save by the most determined pilgrims, chasing some soul-deep yearning to reach its summit. Those hardy few who survive the climb return haunted and empty, or changed beyond all recognition.

sun-disc.title: The Sun Disc
sun-disc.subtitle: Ancient tool of Ascension
sun-disc.description: The tool used by the ancient Shurimans to ascend to godhood. It fell with the ruin of their empire, but now rises to bathe in the sun’s light once more.

immortal-bastion.title: The Immortal Bastion
immortal-bastion.subtitle: Sprawling capital of Noxus
immortal-bastion.description: Once the stronghold of the dread revenant Mordekaiser, now a forbidden vault of mysteries. In its shadow, the capital city of Noxus has grown over many centuries of imperial expansion.

ixaocan.title: Ixaocan
ixaocan.subtitle: The Last Sanctuary
ixaocan.description: Hidden city of the Ixtali. Far older than most outsiders would ever guess, its great arcologies are neither wholly habitats nor colleges of magic, but something in between.

mount-targon.title: Mount Targon
mount-targon.subtitle: Runeterra’s highest peak
mount-targon.description: Runeterra’s highest peak, and the site of many sacred pilgrimages. Its rocky heights have been twisted and elongated, some say drawn upward, by powers beyond mortal comprehension.

demacia-city-landmark.title:
The Great City
of Demacia
demacia-city-landmark.subtitle: Seat of power for the noble houses
demacia-city-landmark.description: King Jarvan III’s seat of power, where the noble houses of Demacia reside. Its mighty walls are heavily defended, the stones themselves reinforced with petricite, a magic-nullifying substance.

frostguard.title:
The Frostguard
Citadel
frostguard.subtitle: Ancient Freljordian stronghold
frostguard.description: An ancient stronghold built to watch over the dark chasm of the Howling Abyss, the Citadel also houses many of the Freljord’s hidden treasures and historical records.

placidium.title:
The Placidium
of Navori
placidium.subtitle: Sacred site of Ionian harmony
placidium.description: The Placidium is one of the First Lands’ most sacred places. Over countless centuries, Ionians have journeyed here to study at renowned schools, or meditate in its wild, magical gardens.

bandle-city.title: Bandle City
bandle-city.subtitle: Mythical land of curious enchantment
bandle-city.description: Opinions differ as to where exactly the home of the yordles is to be found, though many claim to have travelled through unseen portals to a land of curious enchantment. They tell of a place of unfettered magic, where the foolhardy can be led astray by myriad wonders and end up lost in a dream, never to return at all.

the-void.title: The Void
the-void.subtitle: The unknowable nothingness
the-void.description: Screaming into existence with the birth of the universe, the Void is a manifestation of the unknowable nothingness that lies beyond. It is a force of insatiable hunger, waiting through the eons until its masters, the mysterious Watchers, mark the final time of undoing, and so usher in total oblivion across Runeterra.

basilich.title: Basilich
basilich.subtitle: Port city
basilich.description: Port city whose rebellion against the empire was quashed by its very own son, Darius.

belzhun.title: Bel’zhun
belzhun.subtitle: Coastal outpost
belzhun.description: Coastal outpost, known for its thriving black markets and signature mwatis wool.

bilgewater-bay.title: Bilgewater Bay
bilgewater-bay.subtitle: Natural harbor, crammed with settlements
bilgewater-bay.description: A natural harbor in the Blue Flame Isles. Its many haphazard settlements make up the greater city of Bilgewater, a renowned haven for criminal activity in the region.

delverhold.title: The Delverhold
delverhold.subtitle: Mountain fortress
delverhold.description: Mountain fortress, whose rich mines supply Noxus with gold and iron.

fossbarrow.title: Fossbarrow
fossbarrow.subtitle: Haunted town
fossbarrow.description: Named after the late Fossian Crownguard, this town was once haunted by a nightmarish demon.

frostheld.title: Frostheld
frostheld.subtitle: Glacial harbor city
frostheld.description: Situated within a glacial harbor, this city served as the former capital of the Avarosan tribes.

glaserport.title: Glaserport
glaserport.subtitle: Harbor settlement
glaserport.description: Settlement known for its chained wolfships, the natural harbor providing shelter from ice and snow.

ghulfrost.title: Ghulfrost
ghulfrost.subtitle: Ancient Ruins
ghulfrost.description: After traveling unforgiving ice cliffs for days, Ashe reached the edge of her mother's maps: Ghulfrost. Though Grena expected to find Avarosa's Throne, a hall and hoard of treasure, Ashe found merely an unmarked cairn in the snow... only to discover a legendary bow made entirely of True Ice buried in the rocks.

high-silvermere.title: High Silvermere
high-silvermere.subtitle: Highland city
high-silvermere.description: Childhood home of Luxanna and Garen Crownguard, noted for its rocky highlands and silverwing raptors.

hirana-monastery.title: Hirana Monastery
hirana-monastery.subtitle: Sacred site
hirana-monastery.description: Renowned sanctuary for those seeking to better understand their connection to the spirit realm.

kinkou-monastery.title: Kinkou Monastery
kinkou-monastery.subtitle: Sacred site
kinkou-monastery.description: Home of the Kinkou Order, whose warriors are sworn to protect the balance within Ionia.

nashramae.title: Nashramae
nashramae.subtitle: Port city
nashramae.description: Shuriman port famed for its silk, Sun Disc replica, and festival celebrating Rammus.

ornnkaal-rocks.title: Ornnkaal Rocks
ornnkaal-rocks.subtitle: Sacred Site
ornnkaal-rocks.description: A coastal pilgrimage site visited by Sejuani and Ashe's tribes during the summers of their youth, with plentiful fishing and many fields for grazing animals.

piltover-town.title: Piltover
piltover-town.subtitle: Thriving coastal city
piltover-town.description: Piltover is a thriving, progressive city overlooking the ocean. Fleets of ships pass through its titanic sea-gates, bringing goods from all over the world. Merchant clans fund incredible endeavors, including artistic follies and architectural monuments to their individual power. With ever more inventors delving into hextech, Piltover has become the destination for the most skilled craftspeople from across Runeterra.

rakelstake.title: Rakelstake
rakelstake.subtitle: Sacred site
rakelstake.description: A statue of Avarosa guards this sacred site, where Ashe and Tryndamere were oathbound.

temple-pallas.title: Temple of Pallas
temple-pallas.subtitle: Sacred site
temple-pallas.description: The darkin Varus was imprisoned here for centuries, but the seals have since been broken...

trevale.title: Trevale
trevale.subtitle: Farming community
trevale.description: A collection of farming villages clinging to the rocky hillsides, where Riven was born.

uwendale.title: Uwendale
uwendale.subtitle: Farming town
uwendale.description: Often invaded by wyverns, this hunting and farming town was also the birthplace of Quinn.

zaun-town.title: Zaun
zaun-town.subtitle: Polluted undercity
zaun-town.description: Zaun is a polluted undercity beneath Piltover—once united, they are now separate, symbiotic cultures. Stifled inventors often find their unorthodox research welcomed in Zaun, but reckless industry has rendered whole swathes of the city highly toxic. Even so, thanks to a thriving black market, chemtech, and mechanical augmentation, the people still find ways to prosper.

zirima.title: Zirima
zirima.subtitle: Merchant camp
zirima.description: Merchant camp where traders and explorers often gather before venturing into the Great Sai.

ryganns-reach.title: Rygann's Reach
ryganns-reach.subtitle: Cursed Ruins
ryganns-reach.description: Rumored to have been cursed by an evil mage and her son, the settlement that once stood here was burned to the ground many centuries ago.

valars-hollow.title: Valar's Hollow
valars-hollow.subtitle: Trader Settlement
valars-hollow.description: For countless generations, merchants and traders would gather here throughout the winter months, before venturing into the icy north.

marrowmark-market.title: Marrowmark
marrowmark-market.subtitle: Trader Settlement
marrowmark-market.description: Erected in the ribcage of some long-dead desert behemoth, it is said that anything under the sun can be found in the bazaars of Marrowmark... for the right price.

the-city-of-gardens.title: The City of Gardens
the-city-of-gardens.subtitle: Scorched Ruins
the-city-of-gardens.description: This once thriving, beautiful city was destroyed during the apocalyptic Rune Wars. It is said that the entire population was annihilated in one terrible night, the city utterly leveled… and all that remains now lies in ruin.

yetis-vigil.title: Yeti's Vigil
yetis-vigil.subtitle: Ancient Ruins
yetis-vigil.description: Ruins of the lost yeti civilization. Where dreams swirl in snow, an unlikely friendship was born.

foundling-village.title: Foundling Village
foundling-village.subtitle: Frostguard Settlement
foundling-village.description: In the shadow of their great Citadel, the Frostguard shelter children orphaned by the cold.

naljaag.title: Naljaäg
naljaag.subtitle: Cursed Village
naljaag.description: A simple milling settlement beneath a waterfall. Its original name has been lost to stone.

vathcaer.title: Vathcaer
vathcaer.subtitle: Avarosan Settlement
vathcaer.description: Village where Ashe grew up, controlled by her mother Grena. Subsequently destroyed by the Ice Children.

village-of-the-ice-children.title: Village of the Ice Children
village-of-the-ice-children.subtitle: Farming Village
village-of-the-ice-children.description: Settlement of herders and warriors, rivals of the Avarosan tribe.

quchar.title: Quchar
quchar.subtitle: Hearthbound Village
quchar.description: Home of the Ebrataal, a magic-less community who were the first to follow Ashe as the leader of the Avarosan tribe.

yadulsk.title: Yadulsk
yadulsk.subtitle: Coastal Settlement
yadulsk.description: Winter's Claw village where Sejuani's mother Kalkia temporarily settled the tribe during her rule. Traditionally, Winter's Claw tribes relocate every winter, rebuilding their villages out of their ships and scavenged materials.

shadow_harrowing.title: The Harrowing
shadow_harrowing.subtitle: Black Mist of the Shadow Isles

ezrealnotes_featured.title: Who Needs A Map?
ezrealnotes_featured.subtitle: Ezreal’s Field Notes
ezrealnotes_featured.description: Read Ezreal's Field Notes and trace his travels across Runeterra with the latest update to the map.

ezrealnotes1.title: **Oshra Va'zaun**
ezrealnotes1.subtitle: **EZREAL’S FIELD NOTES**
ezrealnotes1.description:
*No one appreciates what’s beneath their feet. I mean, there’s an entire Shuriman outpost buried… uhh, I mean flooded… down under the Sump. Those ancient Shurimans really flexed their imperial muscles, back in their day. (Must have been all that Sun Disc magic?) You never know when—or where—you’re going to find one of their temples, or ossuaries, or arcane reliquaries, filled with esoteric artifacts.*

*The Vault of Resplendent Holies is down here, somewhere, under Zaun, and I’ll bet there’s a whole lot of holies still left to be discovered.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes2.title: **Northern Coastal Cities**
ezrealnotes2.subtitle: **EZREAL’S FIELD NOTES**
ezrealnotes2.description:
*All of this belongs to Noxus. In my experience, one always ends an adventure in enemy territory—so it’s generally wiser not to start there. Sometimes it can’t be avoided, though. For example, Bel’zhun is the place to hire the best Shuriman guides.*

*My first guide, Kasdjar, was especially knowledgeable, charismatic, and hardworking. What he was not, however, was made of iron. That’s why he was smooshed to death by a falling obelisk.*

*Poor Kasdjar, we hardly knew ye.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes3.title: **Into Icathia**
ezrealnotes3.subtitle: **EZREAL’S FIELD NOTES**
ezrealnotes3.description:
*I took one look at this wasteland and was like “Well, that’s beyond my pay grade!”*

*For now.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes4.title: **Look, Nothing Happened!**
ezrealnotes4.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes4.description:
*There’s an island here. It’s not on any maps, but it’s there.*

*I was marooned on that deserted rock for a week. It’s home to a colony of aggressively flirtatious… things? I don’t know. Walruses, maybe?*

*Sailors beware, indeed.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes5.title: **The Oldest Gods**
ezrealnotes5.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes5.description:
*As I outlined in my pioneering work On the Origins of Ascension (self-published, many copies still available) Nerimazeth was the original capital of Shurima. I’m talking waaay back, like, before there was even an empire.
According to my trusty former guide Kasdjar, the land outside this city was home to the first iteration of what is now known as the Sun Disc. That’s got to be right up there on my list of Lost Wonders of the World! I’m guessing this prototype failed because… Well… historically, Sun Discs don’t seem very stable.*

*After Nerimazeth, the Shurimans apparently started over, and built an even a bigger one. Surely, history could not repeat itself?! Heh.*

*I guarantee there’s some interesting stuff buried out there. Old stuff. Priceless stuff.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes6.title: **Walking the Plank**
ezrealnotes6.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes6.description:
*Ah, my inaugural journey! I had stowed away on a mercantile vessel to find the lost tomb of Ne’Zuk, but the captain caught me red handed, pilfering some lime-grog. They were going to throw me overboard, until I convinced them otherwise.*

*As the ship’s logs will attest, “a patch of rough seas” claimed our navigator. My quick thinking (and star charts) not only saved the day, but earned me a field promotion. That’s a big deal, since the navigator is essentially the captain, minus the funny hat.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes7.title: **Where's the Proof**
ezrealnotes7.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes7.description:
*Rumors say the ancient city has risen once more. I’m skeptical.*

*When Ezreal’s field notes say a metropolis is buried… well, it stays buried. Usually.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes8.title: **Too Close for Comfort**
ezrealnotes8.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes8.description:
*I’ll give credit to the Noxians—they do a couple of things well. One of them is ignoring the great, imposing monoliths that practically shimmer with dark energy in the heart of their capital. The other thing is tacos. I strolled the promenades around the Immortal Bastion while sampling their cuisine. Impending dread makes a great taco seasoning, I must say.*

*I was supposed to be meeting with a new contact, to collect some archival materials. She never showed, but a few shady types started following me, and one of them eventually handed me a rose petal. You guessed it, the petal was black. That was enough for me!*

*Found a single black petal every day, until I made it back over the border—one of them was at the bottom of my satchel. Ominous trip.*

*Good tacos, though.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes9.title: **Curtain Call**
ezrealnotes9.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes9.description:
*Jandelle’s this charming hamlet… blah blah blah. What I’m after is a pair of Kindred masks. Not just any Kindred masks, but the originals—carved from the wood of a supposedly bewitched eldlock tree. Real spooky, storybook stuff, eh?*

*But myths are rooted in truth. A famous actress died on stage while playing the dual role of Kindred, in Demacia. Strangest part was, the theatre company said the prop masks created for the performance never left her dressing room.*

*The masks she wore on stage? Vanished. Probably in some collector’s show room. Makes you wonder, though.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes10.title: **Humble Beginnings**
ezrealnotes10.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes10.description:
*Rumor has it, a certain Demacian national treasure—one Jarro Lightfeather—was born around here. Perhaps you’ve heard of him?*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes11.title: **Shhhh.**
ezrealnotes11.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes11.description:
*If the Avarosans ask… just say you haven’t seen me. Got it? GOT IT?*

*This has absolutely nothing to do with that silver totem I procured from the top of a freezing mountain. That was a different guy. We just have the same name. And hair.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes12.title: **Captain's Log**
ezrealnotes12.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes12.description:
*Nothing more awe-inspiring than seeing Mount Targon at night, from the sea… especially when you’re quelling a mutiny.
(Note to self: lime-grog is rationed FOR A REASON)*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes13.title: **The Blue Flame Isles**
ezrealnotes13.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes13.description:
*Little-known fact—these are actually named the Serpent Isles. It’s important to know the local culture.*

*I joined in their ceremonies a few times. There’s a lot more going on than meets the eye. One priestess carries around a massive idol that I desperately want to go back and examine. I got some real “cosmic” vibes from that fetish…*

*Anyway, the Buhru are one of the more secretive religious groups, claiming to predate pretty much everything else on Valoran or Shurima. I suspect their influence is much larger than anyone guesses.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes14.title: **The 'Sand Mother'**
ezrealnotes14.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes14.description:
*This desert is filled with life… and a lot of that life is Xer’Sai. Sure, they’re easy enough to blast to bits with some bullseye shots, but they just keep coming and coming.*

*I took shelter in this circular cavern that I quickly realized was a gargantuan Xer’Sai burrow. My local guide, poor old Kasdjar, swore it was the lair of the Sand Mother—a Xer’Sai large enough to swallow a dormun whole.*

*That was a big NOPE for me. We hightailed it out of there pretty darn quick.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes15.title: **A Glimpse Beyond**
ezrealnotes15.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes15.description:
*All eight tribes of the Southern Dune Wanderers somehow got it into their heads that I’d absconded with their sacred medallion. They chased me through the mountain passes for a week before giving up, and I finally had a chance to rest.*

*(Joke’s on them—my antiquities dealer confirmed the medallion was a fake!)*

*That’s when I saw it. A shimmering gap in the bare rock, opening up to some other realm beyond it. I decided to check it out first thing in the morning.*

*Big mistake. The whole thing had vanished. I camped out for a week, but never saw it again. Was it just a hallucination… or did I find a portal to the mythical Bandle City?*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes16.title: **The Lost Tomb of Ne'Zuk**
ezrealnotes16.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes16.description:
*This one was a bit of a twofer. There was an emperor’s burial chamber, sealed and intact, right here—but it’s definitely not there anymore, because underneath that tomb was where old Ne’Zuk was laid to rest… and Ne’Zuk’s tomb was destroyed.*

*By me.*

*That’s where I found my gauntlet. Pretty cool, huh?*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes17.title: **South of Mudtown**
ezrealnotes17.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes17.description:
*Got into a high-stakes game of Krakenhand with a gang of high-seas marauders, here.*

*Well, I mean, technically they were my captors. But after I proved my worth at the card table, we all became fast friends. They made the mistake of upping the ante on a triple-tentacle dice roll, you see—I was holding a whole hand of nothing, but they didn’t know that. Apparently, my nothing was better than their nothing, once the dice were in play.*

*(Note to self: learn how to play Krakenhand)*

*Won back my gauntlet, along with a nice antique flintlock. Actually, I wonder how the survivors are doing? I should look them up. Great guys. What’s left of them, at least.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes18.title: **The Deep Jungle**
ezrealnotes18.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes18.description:
*Locals call the area around Paretha the “Vale of Silver Mist”, and I can see why. It’s a magical place… all alluring and mysterious.*

*I personally had an out of body experience while hunting for the Elixir of Uloa. I saw myself in the jungle, peering back at me with curious eyes from behind a tree. I looked pretty good. Then the tree talked to me. I swear it followed me for a while.*

*If this doesn’t seem like something you’d enjoy, then you should definitely avoid drinking the taffa-flower water.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes19.title: **Paretha**
ezrealnotes19.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes19.description:
*Ah, Paretha! Such a charming village. Try the taffa-flower water, it’s got a real kick. A tribal shaman here once told me my soul was “entwined with” the Aspect of the Wanderer. Didn’t peg her for a Targonian… but I suppose looks can be deceiving.*

*Anyway, I stole the Elixir of Uloa from a nearby temple. The temple didn’t survive. Probably shouldn’t show my face in Paretha for a while. Let the heat die down, if you know what I mean.*

 -Ez

ezrealnotes20.title: **Here be Sand-Trolls**
ezrealnotes20.subtitle: **Ezreal’s Field Notes**
ezrealnotes20.description:
*Did you know sand-trolls are a thing? I, for one, did not know sand-trolls were a thing.*

*Turns out—sand-trolls, totally a thing.*

 -Ez

junglestory_featured.title: Conquer! For the Glory of Noxus!
junglestory_featured.subtitle: At the Edge of the World
junglestory_featured.description: The jungles of Shurima are a frontier that the most ambitious generals would dearly love to claim for Noxus. Follow the expedition of Commander Ysard Tomyri aboard the frigate *Ardentius*, as she attempts to carve out her place in the annals of history.

jungle_day1.title: Chains of Command
jungle_day1.subtitle: At the Edge of the World
jungle_day1.description: Having petitioned Noxian high command no fewer than seven times, fleet officer Tomyri is finally summoned to the capital to receive a commission of her own.

link.label: Conquer! For the Glory of Noxus!

jungle_day2.title: Leaving the Capital
jungle_day2.subtitle: At the Edge of the World
jungle_day2.description: Tomyri oversees her vessel’s final preparations, before learning that the expedition is to be joined by the renowned Reckoning beast hunter, Niander Ordylon.

link.label: Conquer! For the Glory of Noxus!

jungle_day3.title: The Great River
jungle_day3.subtitle: At the Edge of the World
jungle_day3.description: After many days at sea, the *Ardentius* enters the Serpentine Delta. This is Tomyri’s first real glimpse of the wilderness that awaits her, and her crew.

link.label: Conquer! For the Glory of Noxus!

jungle_day4.title: Their Darkest Hour
jungle_day4.subtitle: At the Edge of the World
jungle_day4.description: The jungle does not treat foreign invaders kindly. Unable to find their bearings, or any quarry for the beast hunters, the Noxians’ morale and discipline begins to falter.

link.label: Conquer! For the Glory of Noxus!
